synth.notes:
Mirror-axis puzzle on 3x3 grid (x=row, pixels x-major, 63x63 board): model = axis row, selection, piece block sets, target block sets.
ACTION5 cycles axis->pieces (by x,y)->axis; ACTION1/2 row -/+3 for selection, ACTION3/4 col -/+3 for pieces only; blocked off-board, piece onto axis row/other piece, axis onto piece row.
Reflection block = (2*axis_block - bx, by); render walls1<targets2<reflections3<pieces4, holes transparent (empty hole: selected 0, reflection 4, else -1), re-extract 4-connected (targets per sprite), names by (x,y), wall index offset = #non-wall 0 pixels.
Stateless parse splits merged pieces via 0-centre blocks grown over ambiguous centres; hidden state only reused on exact continuity. Passes 29/29 also stateless.
Unconfirmed: ACTION5 order beyond axis->first piece (piece->piece->axis assumed); blocking rules never contradicted but only partly exercised.
